✅ Correct Answer: A — Heinz-Harald Frentzen

📖 Explanation:

Heinz-Harald Frentzen matched the 1:21.072 benchmark set by his Williams teammate Jacques Villeneuve and Ferrari's Michael Schumacher during qualifying for the 1997 European Grand Prix.

Because Villeneuve set the lap time first, he was awarded pole position, with Schumacher starting second and Frentzen third. This remains the only three-way tie for pole position in Formula 1 history.
pending.question_text: At the 1997 European Grand Prix at Jerez, three drivers recorded identical qualifying times of 1:21.072. Jacques Villeneuve and Michael Schumacher set it first and second. Who set it third?
